They want a clear migration path: hosted parity -> add compatibility shim for dedicated -> canary rollout. Also request fallbacks (route to existing provider) during ramp. --- Procurement notes: procurement + security require SOC2 evidence, SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS at rest. They prefer committed capacity (annual) but need a firm price for Dedicated nodes + burst. Budget committee meeting 2025-03-15. --- Internal owners: AE Jordan Price, SE Priya Raman.
